title: Teddy Swims & Luke Combs to Lead ‘Incredible Lineup’ for EA Sports’ Madden Bowl 2026
summary: “The last year has been surreal for me, and bringing that energy ... for Madden Bowl is a dream!" Swims tells Billboard.
contentText:
Get ready to “Lose Control” with a great lineup come Super Bowl weekend. Teddy Swims and Luke Combs are set to perform at EA Sports Presents Madden Bowl, Billboard can exclusively announce. The event — which also features Stephen Wilson Jr., Gavin Adcock and rapper LaRussell as part of the music lineup — is set to take place Feb. 6 at Chase Center in San Francisco.

“The last year has been surreal for me, and bringing that energy to Chase Center for Madden Bowl is a dream! Football, the Super Bowl and Madden are such a big part of how people come together, and music is always right there with it,” Swims tells Billboard . “EA Sports has put together an incredible lineup, and I can’t wait to take the stage!”

“I’ve been a Panthers fan my whole life, so naturally, Madden has been a staple for as long as I can remember. We even play it on tour a lot these days,” Combs, who just announced new album The Way I Am a day before, tells Billboard . “It’s super cool EA Sports asked me to be a part of this huge event — the Madden Bowl — and I’m still hopeful my Panthers will be in the Super Bowl while I’m out there.” (As of press time, the country star’s Carolina Panthers are in a tie with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers for the top spot in the NFC South, with both teams with a 8-9 record.)

EA Sports Presents Madden Bowl 2026

Courtesy of EA Sports

Jameis Winston, quarterback for the New York Giants, and sports commentator Kay Adams are set to host Madden Bowl’s blue carpet, which kicks off at 7 p.m. PT. Fans can watch via EA Sports’ social media channels as the stars arrive for the event that combines gaming, music and sports. The social channels will also offer exclusive behind-the-scenes content, including Twitch streamer Sketch hosting a livestream of athletes playing Madden NFL 26 against each other.

“With Super Bowl LX in the backyard of our global headquarters, this year truly feels like a home game for us,” John Reseburg, VP of Marketing, Partnerships and Communications for EA Sports, said in a statement. “This will be our biggest presence ever, and EA Sports Presents Madden Bowl is at the center of it, a celebration of the fans, athletes, creators and music shaping the culture of football. We’re going to bring an incredible show to the Bay, and share that energy with football fans everywhere.”

Madden Bowl has previously featured big names across genres for its annual Super Bowl weekend bash. In 2025, the event’s lineup consisted of Jelly Roll, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton and Tucker Wetmore, while 2024 had iconic pop-punk rockers Green Day, as well as Big Boi with Killer Mike, and Breland.

Super Bowl 60 is set to take place Feb. 8 at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, Calif.
